nodes.description: drainImpl reads outgoingMessages[s->messageIndices[i]]. In the vulnerable version, an orphaned subscriber's stale message index exceeds the cleared vector's size, causing a container-overflow READ.

edges.description: The subscriber orphaned by the incorrect head unlink (s->next at drain time) is the same subscriber that later accesses outgoingMessages with a stale index in drainImpl, establishing a direct pointer-identity causal link from the corruption to the out-of-bounds read.

root_cause_criterion.obligation: When drainableSubscribers == s (s is the head of the linked list), drain(s) must set drainableSubscribers to s->next to preserve the remaining subscribers in the list.
root_cause_criterion.violated_because: The vulnerable code sets drainableSubscribers to nullptr instead of s->next, orphaning all subscribers after the head.
